name: Cross-Asset Carry Tilt - Bond Universe + 8% Vol Target
description: Applies carry-factor tilt across the fixed-income universe (US Treasuries, USD-hedged global aggregate, global high yield, EUR govt bonds, India INR govt bonds), overweighting the highest ex-ante-carry bonds, then scales to 8% annualised volatility target. Captures bond-specific carry opportunities (yield-to-maturity) within a fixed-income sleeve.
